_meta.what: Site-wide fraction (0-1) of PEAK attendance present at each daytime hour. The TOTAL crowd size per hour. Crossed with the organiser's stage program to give per-stage demand. NOT a headcount.

tier_by_limb.fill_to_peak: DERIVED — shape from TUM 'Back to the Woods' measured occupancy (arXiv:1511.00217) + Still 2019 arrival profiles
tier_by_limb.plateau: DERIVED — magnitude ceiling = site_area_m2 x safe_density (Green Guide 2-4.7 persons/m2); validated vs Lyon MADRAS in Phase 5
tier_by_limb.decline: ASSUMED — no source publishes voluntary departure timing; taper is a flagged assumption (and is the LEAST decision-relevant limb — the hot-hour sits in the afternoon fill/plateau)

source: Biedermann et al. 2015, TU Munchen, 'Back to the Woods' occupancy study — arXiv:1511.00217 (noon open; ~50% arrive 16:00-18:00; S-shaped cumulative; peak~5300; decline storm-truncated)
Still 2019, 'Crowd Science and Crowd Counting', Taylor & Francis, DOI:10.1080/2058802X.2019.1594138 (three arrival-profile shapes: early / transport-limited / late)
Guide to Safety at Sports Grounds (Green Guide) 6th ed., SGSA (ingress 660/entry-pt/hr; egress 82/m/min; density 2-4.7/m2)
_meta.validation_yardstick: Lyon MADRAS festival dataset (Zenodo 13830435) — used for crowd DENSITY MAGNITUDE only (night festival; not a daytime shape source). See scripts/crowd_validation/.
_meta.constructed_by: CD-A CRISP-DM Phase 3 (.planning/cd-a-daytime-demand/) — values digitised from the TUM S-shape + Still profiles; see phase-3/decisions.md (CON-001..004)
_meta.units: occupancy = fraction of peak, dimensionless 0-1. hours = local HH:MM.
_meta.usage: occupancy[profile][hour] multiplies the per-stage demand weight (capacity_floor x draw x active) so total on-site demand tracks the curve. Window is the festival's gates-open..close; rescale hours to the organiser's actual window.
_meta.festival_style_knob: The organiser picks a profile. 'early' = family/arts (arrive at open, long dwell). 'transport_limited' = capacity-constrained access. 'late' = headline-driven (TUM-like, surge before the evening peak).
_meta.night_excluded: Curve covers DAYTIME hours only (sun present). Night = no solar load = no shade need = out of scope.

late.label: Late / headline-driven (TUM-anchored default)
late.note: Slow build through the afternoon, steep rise 16:00-18:00 (TUM: ~half arrive in this window), plateau into the evening. Decline after 20:00 ASSUMED.

transport_limited.label: Transport-limited (flat capacity ramp)
transport_limited.note: Access-constrained: arrivals ramp at roughly constant max transport rate, gentler plateau (Still: Sydney-Olympics-type).

early.label: Early / front-loaded (family, arts)
early.note: Crowd arrives near gates-open and dwells; long high plateau through the day.
